description_en: Queries the list of managed agents in a specified workspace
description_zh: 查询指定工作空间下的托管智能体列表
name: ListManagedAgents

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单页最大返回条数，默认 20，取值范围 1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the nextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页令牌。首次调用为空，后续使用上一次响应返回的 nextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token
